property_summary: After a successful transferOwnership(newOwner) by the current owner, the contract's owner() must equal exactly newOwner for any nonzero newOwner; the buggy version instead sets owner to the caller, breaking this for any newOwner != caller.
change_summary: Replaced _transferOwnership(newOwner) with _transferOwnership(_msgSender()) so ownership is always transferred to the caller instead of newOwner.
